In 2009, the age-adjusted suicide rate for the total population (11.8 per 100,000 population)
The suicide rate was higher than the homicide rate among those aged ≥25 years
For persons aged 25-44 years, the rate of suicide was nearly twice the rate of homicide
Sources: National Vital Statistics System mortality data.

methods_quotes.q: Suicide data for persons aged 0–9 years are suppressed based on a child's inability to form and understand suicidal intent and consequences.
